method: source audit plus a bounded deterministic four-channel raw-IQ baseline-error pilot; no AI training
recommended_first_pilot_reason: baseline_error_m already has a first-order angle-dependent phase injection and a known-error inverse model candidate; velocity and servo require a separate true-versus-reported state before faithful injection
known_limitations: pilot baseline_error_m injection applies the audited common right-phase-center rotation to channels 2/4; it is not a complete independent four-channel attitude/geometry model
current stage2 platform_speed_mps drives both true kinematics and emitted metadata, so velocity error is not a faithful unknown-report mismatch
current radar geometry sets theta_true_deg equal to theta_cmd_deg, so servo/beam pointing error has no independent truth path
the new six-pair observable analyzer is an offline raw-IQ interface; it is not yet a production runtime estimator
production B0/B1/B2/B3 CSI/STAP, CFAR Pd/Pfa, target causal transfer and CUDA performance were not run in this pilot
